_comment: Human-facing surfaces outside the PSP Human Card Table. `cards` are individual cards Fernando ruled human-facing; `tables` are whole card tables whose every card is one. The guard enforces the sister-card contract on both. A card the intake agent adopts is appended to `cards`; the `tables` entry is the backstop for one it forgets.

Moved out of Sentry to In progress (9027546460). Pairs with TWO bot cards in Fernando: PSP 48348194, table 10157062382 - 10225414803 (bc3-ios-ipad-restoration-replays-saved-stack-as-animated-pushes) and 10225415490 (bc3-ios-nsinvalidargument-issue-groups-113-unrelated-signatures). Two symptoms on one card, so a split of the board card is recommended. No sister card created. NOTE: board card 9040419171 ('[BC4][iOS] Cannot add self as subview', Not now column, 15 comments, 2025-03-22) is a PRE-EXISTING human card on the SAME Sentry issue 3801825639 - it is NOT adopted and was not touched. Verdict defect-already-fixed (db4ee29, shipped v1.3.4 2026-07-01), so no effort opened and the card stays in the Sentry column (9956253701); recommended next column is Done (9027546463). Sentry disposition: all FIVE issues in the signature family (HEY-DESKTOP-64Q, 64N, 66V, 64G and 66W) are ignored/untilEscalating, verified by fresh read. 66W was brought in after Fernando ruled on 2026-08-20 to resolve the signature in 1.3.4; it was confirmed on its own evidence. RESOLVED-IN-RELEASE COULD NOT BE SET FROM THE AGENT TOOL SURFACE (statusDetails silently dropped, landing a bare plain resolve; reverted, defect row 4073), so setting HEY@1.3.4 by hand in the Sentry UI is OWED TO FERNANDO, with the warning that doing so reopens these roughly every 5 days on upload-time-tagged stragglers. psp-intake-postmortem is owed and deliberately not run by the intake.
